title: Agent Orchestration Event
description: Fan-out trigger event published by anomaly-detector-agent onto agent.orchestration.events when a sentinel.readings anomaly is judged noteworthy. Consumed independently by sentinel-agent and dispatch-agent (two consumer groups on one topic) — the 'Agent Smith Protocol' replication pattern.

anomaly_summary.description: One-line LLM-generated summary of the anomaly

recommended_action.description: LLM-generated recommended next step for responding agents

original_reading.description: The full sentinel.readings payload that triggered this event

examples.anomaly_summary: Stability index collapsed to 14.2 with sustained GLITCH status.
examples.recommended_action: Dispatch a tactical unit and isolate the sector's power feed pending diagnostics.
